controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: Photometrically normalized 550 nm albedo from the 2023 deblurred NEAR MSI release. Display brightness is stretched from 0.05–0.40; this is a monochrome observation, not natural color. The source is registered to the Gaskell shape. Local residual shading may remain.
controls.summary: Corrected 550 nm reflectance is stretched over a 0.05–0.40 range. Some photographed shading remains in the grayscale image.
controls.title: MSI 550 nm reflectance map

controls.label: Near infrared
controls.description: NEAR MSI filter 4 albedo at 950 nm, from the 2023 deblurred release. The near-infrared map is corrected to zero phase and shown in grayscale with the same 0.05–0.40 reflectance range as the 550 nm view. Differences between the views include wavelength-dependent reflectance; this is not natural color or a mineral-abundance measurement. Missing source pixels use the gray grid.
controls.summary: Corrected 950 nm reflectance, using the same brightness scale as the 550 nm view. Near-infrared imagery shown in grayscale.
controls.title: MSI 950 nm albedo map

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Color shows radius minus a 8420 m reference sphere, including the body's broad irregular shape. This is not gravitational height or an image observation. Brightness adds cartographic relief from the full source model; Shadows adds approximate fixed-epoch Sun lighting. Fine terrain is represented in the map while the displayed silhouette is simplified. Values follow the nearest corresponding point on the full source shape within the display mesh’s simplification allowance. This is radial height, not gravitational height; flat previews withhold overlapping radial surfaces.
controls.title: Shape-derived radial height
controls.summary: Model height relative to an 8,420 m sphere. Colors include Eros's broad shape; the outline is simplified.
